name: Deconstructed Deviled Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil. Carefully lower eggs into the pot and cook at a gentle boil for exactly 7 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare an ice bath. Using a slotted spoon, transfer eggs to the ice bath to chill.

When ready to serve, drain and peel eggs. Cut each egg in half lengthwise. Arrange on a serving plate and top each egg with a dollop of mayonnaise, an anchovy fillet, a few capers, and herbs. Drizzle with olive oil and season lightly with salt and pepper. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: deviled egg, deviled egg recipe, easy deviled eggs, oeufs mayonnaise, oeufs mayo

description: In place of re-stuffing hard-boiled eggs, these deconstructed cousins of deviled eggs call for seven-minute eggs with creamy yolks. Top them off with your condiments of choice, like mayonnaise, herbs, spices, bits of bacon, and more.
notes: Optional or for serving: About 1/2 cup homemade mayonnaise, preferably hand-whisked, for serving; Drained brined capers, for garnish; Picked fresh herbs, such as chive segments, chervil leaves, or flat-leaf parsley leaves, for garnish
author: Daniel Gritzer
